title: Knowledge Retrieval and Knowledge Router are no longer built-in agents
reality: v2.3.0 moved optional agents out of the base Engine into downloadable packages published in the Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Agents catalog; fresh installs contain no optional agents ('Fresh installs now contain no optional agents', 25,000+ lines removed). The Marinara-Agents README confirms `knowledge-retrieval` and `knowledge-router` are downloadable Writer Agent packages, installed via Agents -> Download Agents; existing installs migrate their previously available agents automatically.
fix: In the 'Knowledge Retrieval, Router & Sources (Semantic Matching)' section of references/lorebooks.md, stop calling `knowledge-retrieval` and `knowledge-router` 'built-in agents'. State they are downloadable Writer Agent packages (v2.3.0) installed from Agents -> Download Agents (catalog: Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Agents); fresh installs do not have them, and upgrades from pre-2.3 migrate them automatically. Note semantic/vector retrieval over lorebooks therefore requires the package to be installed, not just an embedding connection.

title: Lorebook Keeper is now a downloadable agent package
reality: Since v2.3.0 Lorebook Keeper is a downloadable Misc Agent package (`lorebook-keeper`) in the Marinara-Agents catalog, not built into the Engine; its controls (e.g. in Game setup) appear only when the package is installed ('Made Game setup respect installed agent ownership: Hierarchical Maps, Music DJ, Lorebook Keeper, and Illustrator controls now appear only when their packages are installed'). Fresh installs contain no optional agents.
fix: In references/lorebooks.md, where Lorebook Keeper is referenced (the `locked` field row 'Protect from agent edits (e.g., Lorebook Keeper)' and the v2.1 entry-length note about `save_lorebook_entry` / 'the Lorebook Keeper agent'), add that as of v2.3.0 Lorebook Keeper is an optional downloadable package installed from Agents -> Download Agents; it is absent on fresh installs and must be installed before it can create/update entries.

title: Noodle lorebook context budget is now a fixed 8,192 tokens
reality: The skill (Scope section, v2.2 note) says Noodle lorebook context uses 'a Noodle-specific token budget that scales with active character count'. In v2.3.2 Noodle refreshes were changed so world/lore context and chat carryover each have a fixed 8,192-token budget, specifically so large invited rosters cannot inflate generations.
fix: Update the '(v2.2)' Noodle paragraph in the Scope section of references/lorebooks.md: replace 'a Noodle-specific token budget that scales with active character count' with the v2.3.2 behavior — world/lore (lorebook) context in Noodle refreshes has a fixed 8,192-token budget (chat carryover has its own separate 8,192-token budget), independent of roster size.

title: Semantic similarity is calibrated against an unrelated-text baseline
reality: v2.3.0 (#3627) calibrated Lorebook semantic similarity against an unrelated-text baseline so embedding models whose raw cosine scores cluster around ~0.97 no longer inject unrelated entries at every usable threshold or suppress relevant entries near 1.0. The skill's semantic-matching section documents score thresholds without mentioning this calibration, so a user tuning thresholds would reason about raw cosine values.
fix: In the 'Knowledge Retrieval, Router & Sources (Semantic Matching)' section of references/lorebooks.md (near the v2.2 vector-fallback note), add a v2.3.0 note: similarity scores are calibrated against an unrelated-text baseline before threshold comparison (#3627), so thresholds behave sensibly even with embedding models whose raw cosine scores cluster tightly (e.g. around 0.97); users should not compensate for clustered raw scores when picking thresholds.

title: Prompt macros are resolved before lorebook routing and embedding scans
reality: v2.3.2 (#3704) resolves {{user}}, {{char}}, and other prompt macros in opening greetings and /guided instructions at the final provider boundary, explicitly including lorebook routing and embedding scans, so late injections cannot reach models (or lorebook scanning) as raw placeholders. Relatedly, #3687 (v2.3.2) resolves active Persona, Character, and linked-lorebook macros before Noodle refresh prompts reach the model.
fix: In references/lorebooks.md, add a short note (e.g. in the semantic-matching or keyword best-practices section): since v2.3.2 macros like {{user}}/{{char}} in greetings and /guided instructions are resolved before lorebook routing and embedding scans (#3704), so keys can safely rely on matching real character/persona names rather than raw macro text; linked-lorebook macros are likewise resolved before Noodle refresh prompts (#3687).

title: Editor undo/redo and Tab indent restored in Content/Description fields
reality: v2.3.2 restored native undo and redo in shared text editors including lorebook Content and Description fields, and made Tab / Shift+Tab indent or unindent every selected line without replacing the selection.
fix: Add a bullet to the 'Editor conveniences' subsection of references/lorebooks.md: (v2.3.2) lorebook Content and Description editors support native undo/redo, and Tab / Shift+Tab indent/unindent all selected lines (multi-line indent) instead of replacing the selection.

title: Professor Mari lorebook creation saves entries atomically
reality: #3674 fixed Professor Mari returning blank character or lorebook generation turns and made her lorebook creation save generated entries atomically — a generation no longer leaves a partially saved lorebook.
fix: In the 'AI-assisted lorebook creation (Professor Mari)' section of references/lorebooks.md, add: Mari saves generated entries atomically (all-or-nothing, no partial lorebooks from a failed generation) and no longer returns blank lorebook-generation turns (#3674).

title: Lorebook links protected from duplicate rows by file-native constraints
reality: v2.3.0 removed the legacy database compatibility stack (storage is file-native throughout) and made file-native primary and natural-key constraints enforceable during atomic inserts/updates, preventing concurrent lorebook links from persisting ambiguous duplicates.
fix: In references/lorebooks.md (Scope section or the Character Lorebook tab bullet), add a v2.3.0 note: storage is now file-native and lorebook links are protected by natural-key constraints — concurrent or repeated link operations cannot persist ambiguous duplicate links.

title: Lorebook Prompt Position control not documented
reality: v2.3.3 (#3733) references a 'Lorebook Prompt Position' native selector in the shared Lorebook editor shell (fixed to stay visually stable under Accent Pulse), i.e. there is a lorebook-editor-level prompt-position control in current UI. The skill documents only the per-entry `position` field.
fix: In references/lorebooks.md (UI Location or Editor conveniences), document the Lorebook Prompt Position selector in the lorebook editor and how it relates to the per-entry `position` field; verify its exact semantics against the Engine UI/source before writing the description.
